supersession_reason: V1 cannot be executed faithfully as written. Under the exact-id arm registry in scripts/orion_formal_discovery_arms.py its 17 registered arm ids resolve to 5 procedures: every named published-method parent (STRUCTURE_MAPPING_PARENT, ANTI_UNIFICATION_OR_MDL_PARENT_WHEN_APPLICABLE, FCA_PARENT_WHEN_APPLICABLE) and both federation ids collapse onto PARENT_GENERIC, and three control ids (SEMANTIC_RETRIEVAL, SEMANTIC_RETRIEVAL_OF_EXISTING_FORMALISM, LOCAL_PATCH_OR_EXTRA_VARIABLE) have no procedure designed at all. V2 discharges the CONSTRUCTIBILITY obligation that PR #269 deferred to this lane.
selection_rule: Exactly one arm id per distinct procedure class implemented in ARM_PROCEDURE_CLASS, campaign-wide. The criterion is procedure identity, which is independent of any R2 outcome; no arm was added or removed on the basis of how it scored. V1's FM/FG naming split gave two ids to one procedure (TARGET_ONLY_DIRECT / CURRENT_FORMALISM_ONLY, F2_STATIC_NO_TRANSFER_DISCOVERY / F2_STATIC_NO_FORMALISM_GENESIS, F2_TRANSFER_DISCOVERY_FULL / F2_FORMALISM_GENESIS_FULL, FIXED_LESSON_INJECTION / FIXED_FORMALISM_LESSON_INJECTION). That is the same defect this plan is repairing, so V2 does not exempt itself from it: one id, used in both families. The retained procedure text already covers both (F2_STATIC reads 'do not perform open-ended transfer discovery, conceptual revision, or formalism genesis'), so nothing family-specific is lost.

deferred_arms_pending_procedure_design.STRUCTURE_MAPPING_PARENT: Gentner-style structure mapping. Registered by V1, class PARENT_GENERIC - the same procedure as STRONGEST_DOMAIN_FORMAL_PARENT. Registering it as a parent baseline requires a structure-mapping procedure of its own.
deferred_arms_pending_procedure_design.ANTI_UNIFICATION_OR_MDL_PARENT_WHEN_APPL: Plotkin-style anti-unification / MDL. Same: class PARENT_GENERIC, no procedure of its own.
deferred_arms_pending_procedure_design.FCA_PARENT_WHEN_APPLICABLE: Formal concept analysis. Same: class PARENT_GENERIC, no procedure of its own.
deferred_arms_pending_procedure_design.F0_PARENT_FEDERATION: A federation registered as distinct from the single strongest parent, but class PARENT_GENERIC. Requires a federation procedure that differs from the single-parent one. This is the pair whose contrast the R2 terminal reported; see the erratum.
deferred_arms_pending_procedure_design.F0_FORMAL_PARENT_FEDERATION: The FG-family federation id. Same obligation.
deferred_arms_pending_procedure_design.SEMANTIC_RETRIEVAL: ARM_PROCEDURE_CLASS = None: registered, procedure never designed. Also requires a retrieval corpus - the executor prompt states 'No network retrieval' and none is supplied.
deferred_arms_pending_procedure_design.LOCAL_PATCH_OR_EXTRA_VARIABLE: ARM_PROCEDURE_CLASS = None: registered, procedure never designed.
deferred_arms_pending_procedure_design.CURRENT_FORMALISM_ONLY: Not a design obligation - a duplicate id for the DIRECT procedure, dropped by the selection rule above. Re-register it only if the FG floor is ever given a procedure distinct from TARGET_ONLY_DIRECT.

deferred_arms_rule: A deferred arm may be registered only once its own procedure exists in ARM_PROCEDURE_CLASS, distinct from every other registered arm's. Registering it earlier publishes a named baseline that is a label on a shared procedure.

excluded_from_generated_campaign.FM70: held-out contextual regime selector requires development/test fold construction rather than a standalone exact generated formal task
excluded_from_generated_campaign.FM80: naturalistic mathematics-science transfer requires real domains and independent adjudication
excluded_from_generated_campaign.FG90: real frontier lane remains exploratory and cannot be converted into synthetic confirmatory evidence
